profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA, USA. Its site presents Claude as its AI, described as built for problem solvers and aimed at complex challenges, data analysis, writing code, and hard thinking work.

The company's tracked products center on that model. Claude is listed as a general LLM assistant. Anthropic Console is described as an API management console with prompt testing, evaluation tools, usage monitoring, and cost controls. Claude Code is listed for agentic coding. Computer Use (Anthropic) is described as a computer control agent for desktop automation and system access. A registry entry associated with Anthropic lists an MCP server described as "LLM Orchestration Agent (Langchain Anthropic)."

Anthropic's litigation record is substantial. Named cases include Edelson, PC, et al. v. Anthropic, PBC in the Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit; Brunell v. Anthropic PBC in the District Court, D. Vermont; Gribble v. Anthropic PBC and Haugland v. Anthropic PBC in the District Court, D. Hawaii; Haugland v. Anthropic PBC and University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC in the District Court, D. Delaware; Patel v. Anthropic, PBC, Smith v. Anthropic, PBC, Pascual v. Anthropic, PBC, Shakespeare v. Anthropic PBC, and Kahn v. Anthropic PBC in the District Court, N.D. California; and GROSSINGER v. ANTHROPIC, PBC. in the District Court, E.D. Pennsylvania. A tally of litigation exposure lists 237 cases in California.
